# Penapis Air Kesihatan

Official website: https://penapisairkesihatan.my

Penapis Air Kesihatan is a local water-filter retail and service business at 84, Jalan Intan 12, Taman Cahaya Masai, 81700 Pasir Gudang, Johor, Malaysia. The business can be contacted at +60 17-710 6169 or info@penapisairkesihatan.my.

The business is operated by CAHAYA SUKMAR (JM0510596X / 200803055593), registered in Johor and commenced on 24 March 2008.
